window.

images demonstrate adequate placement of the biopsy needle. The usual number                                
specimen radiograph confirms the presence of calcifications.

A hourglass shaped Eviva biopsy clip was deployed at the biopsy site. Residual calcifications were present post core
biopsy.

window.

introducer needle was placed prior to insertion of the biopsy needle. Biopsy was performed using a 9-gauge EVIVA
vacuum-assisted breast biopsy standard needle utilizing a lateral-medial approach. Confirmatory pre-and post-fire
images demonstrate adequate placement of the biopsy needle. The usual number                            
specimen radiograph confirms the presence of calcifications.
